name: Canvas play
summary: The centred Play control on a slide canvas: a round Vivid Pink disc with the play glyph, in md, lg and hero (96px) sizes, with the deck focus ring.
lead: ONE custom element — <aha-canvas-play> — the Play control a video or media slide draws in the middle of its canvas. A native button, so Enter and Space activate it and the host listens for `click`. The disc is --aha-color-primary with the white system-play glyph and no shadow; hover and press step to --aha-color-primary-hover / -active. Keyboard focus draws the deck focus ring (a 2px gap in the deck background, a 2px ring in the deck ink, both written by applyCanvasDeck), so it reads on light, dark and photo decks.
codeNote: Same element, same shadow-DOM CSS → identical render across frameworks. Attributes only; the host listens for the native `click`.

spec.label: Disc
spec.value: circle (border-radius 50%), --aha-color-primary fill, no border, no shadow; md 48, lg 64 (default), hero 96

spec.label: Glyph
spec.value: system-play, white (--aha-text-inverse), 24px on md and 32px on lg and hero (the icon grid has no larger size), nudged 2px right so the triangle reads centred

spec.label: States
spec.value: hover --aha-color-primary-hover, press --aha-color-primary-active, disabled 50% opacity and inert; background transition --aha-motion-mid, off under reduced motion

spec.label: Focus
spec.value: :focus-visible only: 2px --aha-button-focus-gap then 2px --aha-button-focus-ring (the deck background and ink once applyCanvasDeck has run)

props.name: size
props.desc: 48 / 64 / 96px disc. hero is the centred in-canvas Play

props.name: label
props.desc: Accessible name of the button; pass a translated string in the product

whenToUse.when: the one Play control centred on a video or media slide before it runs
any other action: a canvas action bar uses <aha-button size="lg"> (variant secondary-deck / primary)

opinion.note: Never rebuild it as a hand-sized disc or a 96px aha-button, and never add a shadow: the disc is flat, the deck focus ring is the only chrome.

snippets.label: HTML
snippets.note: The native form — a web component in an HTML file renders on open, no build step.

conformance.$about: Measured by qa.mjs against the RENDERED UI (getComputedStyle via headless CDP). Leaf = ONE shared element, single render.

highlights: Round play disc on --aha-color-primary, white system-play glyph, no shadow
Deck focus ring from applyCanvasDeck, so it shows on every deck

a11y.role: native <button> with an aria-label (default "Play"); the glyph is decorative
a11y.keyboard: Tab to focus, Enter or Space to activate, deck focus ring on :focus-visible
